input_text: Kavya enters a marriage on paper with Samar, who cooks at a street-side ramen cart, because her grandmother is very ill and wishes to see her wed. Samar is ridiculed by her mother and her aunts at every gathering, and they urge Kavya to leave him. Without a word, Samar settles the unpaid rent the relatives owe. When the owner of the property serves the entire household an eviction warning, we learn Samar secretly holds the title to the building. At dinner he rips the warning and says he is the owner. Kavya sees that the arrangement on paper has grown into something real, and her mother has to say sorry to a ramen cook.
